  • Method Details

    • estimatePositions

      public void estimatePositions(List<SecurityPositionSummary> positions, ToDoubleFunction<String> rateToMain)
      Estimates the disposal costs of every open position of a report and stores them on the positions. Closed positions, margin instruments, cash accounts shown as securities and comparison-only rows are left without an estimate.
      Parameters:
      positions - the valued positions of the report
      rateToMain - exchange rate of a currency into the main currency at the report date; it may throw when no rate is available, which leaves the account value of a tiered fee model unknown

    • estimateSell

      public DisposalEstimate estimateSell(Security security, double units, double price, Integer fallbackAccount)
      Estimates the costs of selling the given units, as shown on the hypothetical sale of the transaction list. The value of the security accounts is not known there, so a fee model grading its commission by it stays incomplete; the total values of the portfolio and of the tenant are known from the daily total value.
      Parameters:
      security - the security sold
      units - the units of the position
      price - the price of the hypothetical sale
      fallbackAccount - the account taking all units when the collector knows none, may be null
      Returns:
      the estimate in security currency

    • transferMarkup

      public DisposalCostEstimator.TransferMarkup transferMarkup(Cashaccount cashaccount, List<Securityaccount> portfolioAccounts, String mainCurrency, double amount)
      Estimates the markup of converting the balance of a cash account, together with the net proceeds of the securities settling in its currency, into the main currency. The fx section is the one of the security account connected to the cash account, otherwise the one shared by all security accounts of the portfolio.
      Parameters:
      cashaccount - the cash account
      portfolioAccounts - the security accounts of the portfolio of the cash account
      mainCurrency - the currency of the report
      amount - the amount to convert in the currency of the cash account
      Returns:
      the markup, 0 percent without detail for an account in the main currency or with nothing to convert
